clips.title: The story
paras: At the Tor'kren Farm in western Durotar, Misha Tor'kren waits for word of her son. Kron went west toward the Southfury River to hunt crocolisks, but has not returned.

Misha Tor'kren tends her farm near Thunder Ridge, southeast of the ridge. Her son Kron went west toward the Southfury River to hunt crocolisks and prove his mettle, but he never came home. With Durotar's frontier dangers stretching the orcish watchtowers thin, Misha has no word of where he is. She needs travelers willing to search the riverbanks for signs of her son.
